modeTransition.reason: This is a DEMOTION that makes the record less claim-bearing, not a promotion. 015 is self-delivered: its ten scopes implement specs/015-recommendation-outcome-ledger-and-track-record itself, so a product-to-planning classification let a fully-planned-but-entirely-unbuilt packet rest at a terminal-looking status. The classification also made delivery unreachable by construction. product-to-delivery and full-delivery both declare statusCeiling done and neither declares terminalAliases, so their only legal statuses are not_started, in_progress, blocked and done; specs_hardened is not among them. Holding workflowMode product-to-delivery while status remained specs_hardened therefore could not resolve a transition contract at all: transition-contract-resolver.sh reaches its default branch and, because specs_hardened is absent from the empty terminalAliases array, exits 69 with E009-TARGET-MISMATCH 'current terminal state contradicts the registry-derived target'. Mechanism verified by reading transition-contract-resolver.sh lines 290-297 this run rather than inferred from symptom. Since no implementation-capable mode in this registry accepts specs_hardened, the pair (delivery mode, specs_hardened) is unreachable, and moving status down to in_progress is the only truthful way to carry a delivery mode. in_progress is also simply the accurate description: 0 of 10 scopes are built.

This record deliberately mirrors 013's key schema (at, authority, authorizedBy, from, to, reason, conventionBasis, gateEffect, honestDisclosure, boundedRun) so the two packets are structurally comparable. 013 sits today at exactly the end state this change produces: a done-ceiling delivery mode, status in_progress, every scope not_started, and delivery-completion gates honestly failing.
